monster_movement_types.quote: The color of the border indicates the monster’s movement type (Black – normal, Red – fast, Yellow – stationary, Blue – flying, Green – special).

rows.name: Ambush
rows.quote: Ambush: Once combat has begun with this creature, the investigator no longer has the option to flee it, but must instead fight until one or the other is defeated.

rows.name: Endless
rows.quote: Endless: A monster with this ability cannot be collected as a monster trophy. Instead, each time it is defeated, return it to the cup.

rows.name: Physical Resistance
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Resistance: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type can only provide half its normal bonus (rounded up).

rows.name: Magical Resistance
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Resistance: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type can only provide half its normal bonus (rounded up).

rows.name: Physical Immunity
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Immunity: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type provides none of its normal bonus.

rows.name: Magical Immunity
rows.quote: Physical/Magical Immunity: A Weapon or Spell that adds a bonus of the resisted type provides none of its normal bonus.

rows.name: Nightmarish X
rows.quote: Nightmarish X: Any investigator that passes a Horror check when facing this monster still loses X Sanity. This ability doesn’t apply if the investigator fails the Horror check.

rows.name: Overwhelming X
rows.quote: Overwhelming X: Any investigator that defeats this monster in combat still loses X Stamina. This ability doesn’t apply when the investigator fails his Combat check against the monster.

awakening_open_gates.quote: If too many gates are open at once, the Ancient One can immediately awaken.

monster_limit.note_quote: If the terror level reaches 10, Arkham is overrun, which means that the monster limit is removed for the rest of the game.

outskirts_limit.quote: When the number of monsters in the Outskirts of Arkham exceeds this limit, place all of those monsters back in the cup and raise the terror level by 1.

terror_level_events.quote: For every step the terror level increases, return one Ally at random from the Ally deck to the box.

rows.event: Arkham is overrun (no monster limit and add one doom token).

location_stability.quote: Locations with green diamonds are stable. Monsters and gates will never appear in these locations

board_structure.quote: The Arkham city section of the board shows the city of Arkham divided into 9 neighborhoods, each of which has between 2 and 3 important locations in it, as well as a street area (B).
board_structure.special_areas_quote: The City Limits section of the board contains three special areas: Outskirts (E), The Sky (F) and Lost in Time and Space (G).

special_card_limit.quote: In most cases, a player may never have more than one copy of each special card at the same time. This rule applies to Retainers, Bank Loans, Silver Twilight Memberships, and Bless/Curse cards.

victory_conditions.quote: The investigators win the game in any of the following three ways:

rows.name: A. Close the Gates
rows.quote: When the last gate is closed, the players must have a number of gate trophies equal to or greater than the number of players.

rows.name: B. Seal the Gates
rows.quote: If, at any time, there are six or more elder sign tokens on the board, the players immediately win.

rows.name: C. Banish the Ancient One
rows.quote: If the Ancient One awakens (see page 20) but the investigators manage to defeat it

locations.name: Bank of Arkham
locations.special_ability_text: Bank Loan: Instead of having an encounter here, you may take out a Bank Loan if you don't have one yet.

locations.name: Arkham Asylum
locations.special_ability_text: Psychiatric Care: Instead of having an encounter here, you may recover Sanity by receiving psychiatric care. You may either regain 1 Sanity for free, or pay $2 to restore your Sanity to its maximum value.

locations.name: River Docks
locations.special_ability_text: Shady Character: Instead of having an encounter here, you may spend 5 toughness worth of monster trophies or 1 gate trophy to gain $5.

locations.name: Science Building
locations.special_ability_text: Dissection: Instead of having an encounter here, you may spend 5 toughness worth of monster trophies or 1 gate trophy to gain 2 Clue tokens.

locations.name: Administration Building
locations.special_ability_text: Classes: Instead of having an encounter here, you may pay $8 to draw 2 Skills. Keep one of them and discard the other.

locations.name: St. Mary's Hospital
locations.special_ability_text: Medical Care: Instead of having an encounter here, you may recover Stamina by receiving medical care. You may either regain 1 Stamina for free, or pay $2 to restore your Stamina to its maximum value.

locations.name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
locations.special_ability_text: Magic Lessons: Instead of having an encounter here, you may pay $5 to draw 2 Spells. Keep one of them and discard the other.

locations.name: Ma's Boarding House
locations.special_ability_text: Recruit: Instead of having an encounter here, you may spend 10 toughness worth of monster trophies, 2 gate trophies, or 5 toughness worth of monster trophies and 1 gate trophy to take 1 Ally of your choice from the Ally deck.

locations.name: South Church
locations.special_ability_text: Blessing: Instead of having an encounter here, you may spend 5 toughness worth of monster trophies or 1 gate trophy to have any investigator you choose be Blessed.

locations.name: General Store
locations.special_ability_text: Shop: Instead of having an encounter here, you may draw 3 Common Items and purchase one of them for its list price. Discard the other two items.

locations.name: Curiositie Shoppe
locations.special_ability_text: Shop: Instead of having an encounter here, you may draw 3 Unique Items and purchase one of them for its list price. Discard the other two items.

locations.name: Police Station
locations.special_ability_text: Deputized: Instead of having an encounter here, you may spend 10 toughness worth of monster trophies, 2 gate trophies, or 5 toughness worth of monster trophies and 1 gate trophy to become the Deputy of Arkham. Take the Deputy of Arkham card.

ability.name: Studious
ability.text: Any Phase: Whenever Amanda draws one or more cards from the Skill deck, she draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

ability.name: Scrounge
ability.text: When Pete draws from the Common Item, Unique Item, or Spell deck, he may draw from either the top or the bottom of that deck, his choice. Pete may look at the bottom card of those decks at any time.

ability.name: Shrewd Dealer
ability.text: Any Phase: Whenever Bob draws one or more cards from the Common Item deck, he draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

ability.name: Psychology
ability.text: Upkeep: Dr. Fern may restore 1 Sanity to herself or another character in her location. She cannot raise a character's Sanity higher than that character's maximum Sanity.

ability.name: Hometown Advantage
ability.text: Town Encounter: When drawing location encounters in Arkham, Darrell draws two cards and may choose whichever one of the two he wants. This ability does not work when drawing gate encounters in Other Worlds.

random_possessions.text: 1 Common Item, 1 Unique Item, 2 Spells, 1 Skill

ability.name: Magical Gift
ability.text: Any Phase: Whenever "The Great" Drake draws one or more cards from the Spell deck, he draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

ability.name: Psychic Sensitivity
ability.text: Other World Encounter: When drawing gate encounters in Other Worlds, Gloria draws two cards that match the color of one of the Other World's encounter symbols, then chooses whichever one of the two she wants. This ability does not work when drawing location encounters in Arkham.

ability.name: Strong Mind
ability.text: Any Phase: Harvey reduces all Sanity losses he suffers by 1, to a minimum of 0.

random_possessions.text: 2 Common Items, 1 Unique Item, 1 Spell, 1 Skill

ability.name: Hunches
ability.text: Any Phase: Joe rolls one extra bonus die when he spends a Clue token to add to a roll.

random_possessions.text: 1 Common Item, 1 Unique Item, 2 Spells, 1 Skill

ability.name: Science!
ability.text: Any Phase: Gates and monsters cannot appear in Kate's location due to her flux stabilizer. Monsters and gates do not disappear if she enters their location, however, and monsters can move into her location as usual. * Do not place a Clue token on the Science Building to start the game.

ability.name: Research
ability.text: Any Phase: Once per turn, Mandy can activate this ability after any investigator (including herself) makes a skill check. That investigator then re-rolls all of the dice rolled for that check that did not result in successes.

ability.name: Strong Body
ability.text: Any Phase: Michael reduces all Stamina losses he suffers by 1, to a minimum of 0.

fixed_possessions.text: $7, 1 Clue Token, 2 Common Items (Bull Whip, .38 Revolver)

ability.name: Archaeology
ability.text: Any Phase: Whenever Monterey draws one or more cards from the Unique Item deck, he draws one extra card and then discards one of the cards.

fixed_possessions.text: $0, Blessing, 1 Common Item (Cross), 1 Unique Item (Holy Water)

ability.name: Guardian Angel
ability.text: Any Phase: Sister Mary is never Lost in Time and Space. Instead, if her Sanity is 0, she returns to Arkham Asylum. If her Stamina is 0, she returns to St. Mary's Hospital. If neither her Sanity nor her Stamina are 0, she returns to South Church.

ability.name: Physician
ability.text: Upkeep: Dr. Lee may restore 1 Stamina to himself or another character in his location. He cannot raise a character's Stamina higher than that character's maximum Stamina.

ancient_ones.name: Azathoth
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Since Azathoth promises nothing except destruction, only the insane worship him. However, their fanaticism gives them strength. Maniacs have their toughness increased by 1.
ancient_ones.power_text: If Azathoth awakens, the game is over and the investigators lose.
ancient_ones.attack_text: The end is here! Azathoth destroys the world.

ancient_ones.name: Cthulhu
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Cthulhu's worshippers often have the Innsmouth Look, a sign of monstrous ancestors. Cultists have a horror rating of -2 and a horror damage of 2 Sanity.
ancient_ones.power_text: While Cthulhu stirs in his slumber, investigators have their maximum Sanity and maximum Stamina reduced by 1.
ancient_ones.attack_text: Each investigator lowers either his maximum Sanity or maximum Stamina by 1 (his choice). After Cthulhu attacks, 1 doom token is placed back on Cthulhu's doom track if it isn't already full.

ancient_ones.name: Hastur
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Hastur's worshippers ride byakhee mounts that they call with enchanted whistles. Cultists are flying monsters and their combat rating is -2.
ancient_ones.power_text: While Hastur stirs in his slumber, the cost to seal a gate is 8 Clue tokens instead of 5.
ancient_ones.start_of_battle_text: X is set to the current terror level.
ancient_ones.attack_text: Each investigator must pass a Luck (+1) check or lose 2 Sanity. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

ancient_ones.name: Ithaqua
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Ithaqua's worshippers eat the flesh of their fellow men, gaining supernatural power through their dark practice. Cultists have their toughness increased by 2.
ancient_ones.power_text: While Ithaqua stirs in his slumber, any investigator in a street area at the end of the Mythos Phase loses 1 Stamina. In addition, all Weather cards are discarded without their special effects taking place.
ancient_ones.start_of_battle_text: Investigators must roll a die for every item they have, discarding the item on a failure.
ancient_ones.attack_text: Each investigator must pass a Fight (+1) check or lose 2 Stamina. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

ancient_ones.name: Nyarlathotep
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Nyarlathotep has innumerable cults all over the world. Cultists have the Endless ability.
ancient_ones.power_text: At the start of the game, add the 5 Mask monsters to the cup. Multiple Mask monsters can be in play at once.
ancient_ones.start_of_battle_text: Any investigator with no Clue tokens is devoured.
ancient_ones.attack_text: Each investigator must pass a Lore (+1) check or lose 1 Clue token. Any investigator with no Clue tokens left is devoured. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

ancient_ones.name: Shub-Niggurath
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Shub-Niggurath's young are numberless. Dark Young have the Endless ability.
ancient_ones.power_text: While Shub-Niggurath stirs in her slumber, all monsters have their toughness increased by 1.
ancient_ones.start_of_battle_text: Any investigator with no monster trophies is devoured.
ancient_ones.attack_text: Each investigator must pass a Sneak (+1) check or lose 1 monster trophy. Any investigator with no monster trophies left is devoured. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

ancient_ones.name: Yig
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Yig's worshippers are actually disguised serpent people. Their bite is highly poisonous. Cultists have a combat rating of +0 and a combat damage of 4 Stamina.
ancient_ones.power_text: While Yig stirs in his slumber, he gains a doom token whenever a Cultist is defeated or an investigator is lost in time and space.
ancient_ones.start_of_battle_text: Every investigator is Cursed. Any investigator that already has a Curse is devoured.
ancient_ones.attack_text: Each investigator must pass a Speed (+1) check or lose 1 Sanity and 1 Stamina. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

ancient_ones.name: Yog-Sothoth
ancient_ones.worshippers_text: Yog-Sothoth's worshippers have powerful magical abilities. Cultists have Magical Immunity and a combat rating of -1.
ancient_ones.power_text: While Yog-Sothoth stirs in his slumber, the difficulty to close or seal a gate increases by 1. In addition, any investigator lost in time and space is devoured.
ancient_ones.start_of_battle_text: Any investigator with no gate trophies is devoured.
ancient_ones.attack_text: Each investigator must pass a Will (+1) check or lose 1 gate trophy. Any investigator with no gate trophies left is devoured. This check's modifier decreases by 1 each turn (+0 the 2nd turn, -1 the 3rd turn, etc.)

cards.name: Alien Technology
cards.text: Mi-Go have their toughness increased by 2. If an investigator passes a Combat check against a Mi-Go, he draws 1 extra Unique Item.

cards.name: All Quiet in Arkham!
cards.text: Each player may pass a Luck (-1) check to be Blessed.

rules_notes.text: Despite the name of the card, investigators in other worlds too may try to pass the check.

cards.name: An Evil Fog
cards.text: Will checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Fliers do not move.

cards.name: A Strange Plague
cards.text: Investigators cannot gain Stamina except by receiving medical care in St. Mary's Hospital (or from Vincent Lee).

cards.name: Big Storm Sweeps Arkham!
cards.text: All monsters in the Sky and Outskirts are returned to the cup.

cards.name: Bizarre Dreams Plague Citizens!
cards.text: All Gugs and Nightgaunts in Arkham are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

cards.name: Blackest Night
cards.text: Luck checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus.

cards.name: Blood Magic
cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in Rivertown streets may choose to delve into dark mysteries using their life force. They roll dice equal to their current Stamina, and for every failed die, they lose 1 Stamina. If this reduces them to 0 Stamina, they are devoured and the player must start a new character. Otherwise, they gain 3 Clue tokens.

cards.name: Blue Flu!
cards.text: All investigators in jail are released. No investigators may be arrested until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

cards.name: Campus Security Increased!
cards.text: All monsters in the Miskatonic U. Streets or Locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: The Chill of the Grave
cards.text: All Undead monsters have their toughness increased by 1

cards.name: Church Group Reclaims Southside!
cards.text: All monsters in the Southside streets or locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: City Gripped by Blackouts!
cards.text: The General Store, Curiositie Shoppe, and Ye Olde Magick Shoppe are closed until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

cards.name: Curfew Enforced
cards.text: Any investigator who ends his movement in the streets must pass a Will (+0) check or be arrested and taken to the Police Station.

rules_notes.text: Curfew Enforced does not apply to The Deputy of Arkham.

cards.name: Darke's Carnival Arrives
cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Northside streets gain 1 Clue token from the sinister wonders they witness, but must pass a Will (-1) check or lose 1 Sanity.

cards.name: Disturbing the Dead
cards.text: Roll a die at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it entered play). On a 1 or 2, increase the terror level by 1. If a single player discards 2 gate trophies during the Arkham Encounter Phase while in the Rivertown streets, return this card to the box. Each player draws 1 Spell. If the terror level reaches 10, return this card to the box. Every investigator is Cursed.
cards.ongoing_effect: Roll a die at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it entered play). On a 1 or 2, increase the terror level by 1.
cards.pass_condition: If a single player discards 2 gate trophies during the Arkham Encounter Phase while in the Rivertown streets, return this card to the box. Each player draws 1 Spell.
cards.fail_condition: If the terror level reaches 10, return this card to the box. Every investigator is Cursed.

cards.name: Dreams of a Sunken City
cards.text: Investigators cannot gain Sanity except by receiving psychiatric care at Arkham Asylum (or from Carolyn Fern).

cards.name: Egyptian Exhibit Visits Miskatonic U.
cards.text: Any investigator who ends his movement in the Miskatonic U. streets may pass a Lore (-1) check to gain 1 Clue token by reading the strange hieroglyphics on the artifacts in the exhibit.

cards.name: Estate Sale
cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the Uptown streets may draw 2 Unique Items and purchase one, none, or both of them at list price, discarding any that are not purchased.

cards.name: Family Found Butchered!
cards.text: The terror level increases by 1 in light of this tragic news.

cards.name: Feds Raid Arkham!
cards.text: All monsters in the streets are returned to the cup.

rules_notes.text: This event does not apply to Spawn monsters.

cards.name: The Festival
cards.text: Cultists and Byakhees have their toughness increased by 1.

cards.name: Fourth of July Parade!
cards.text: Investigators cannot move into or out of the Merchant Dist. streets until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

cards.name: Gangs Clean Up Easttown!
cards.text: All monsters in the Easttown streets or locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: Ghost Ship Docks by Itself!
cards.text: An ancient ghost ship arrives in Arkham, releasing 2 monsters into the Merchant Dist. streets.

cards.name: Goat-like Creature Spotted in Woods!
cards.text: All Dark Young in Arkham are returned to the cup. If at least one monster returns to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

cards.name: Good Work Undone
cards.text: When this card enters play, place 6 Clue tokens on it. Any player may spend Clue tokens during the Arkham Encounter Phase while in the Easttown streets to discard Clue tokens from this card on a 1-for-1 basis. Roll two dice at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play). For every 1 or 2 rolled, place one Clue token on this card. If there are no Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each player draws one unique item. If there are 10 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. All elder sign tokens are removed from the board.
cards.ongoing_effect: Roll two dice at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play). For every 1 or 2 rolled, place one Clue token on this card.
cards.pass_condition: If there are no Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. Each player draws one unique item.
cards.fail_condition: If there are 10 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. All elder sign tokens are removed from the board.

cards.name: The Great Ritual
cards.text: Cultists, Witches, Warlocks, and High Priests have their toughness increased by 2 while this card is in play. Place 1 clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play). If a single player discards 3 spells (4 if there are 5 or more players) while in the French Hill streets during the Arkham Encounters phase, return this card to the box. Each player gains 2 clue tokens. If there are ever 5 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. From now on, draw 2 Mythos cards each Mythos Phase. Ignore everything on the first card except for the gate opening.
cards.ongoing_effect: Cultists, Witches, Warlocks, and High Priests have their toughness increased by 2 while this card is in play. Place 1 clue token on this card at the end of every Mythos Phase (beginning the turn after it entered play).
cards.pass_condition: If a single player discards 3 spells (4 if there are 5 or more players) while in the French Hill streets during the Arkham Encounters phase, return this card to the box. Each player gains 2 clue tokens.
cards.fail_condition: If there are ever 5 Clue tokens on this card, return it to the box. From now on, draw 2 Mythos cards each Mythos Phase. Ignore everything on the first card except for the gate opening.

cards.name: Happy Days are Here Again
cards.text: Due to the renewed prosperity that has come to Arkham, the terror level cannot increase.

cards.name: Heat Wave
cards.text: Fight checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty. Lore checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Fire Vampires have their toughness increased by 1.

cards.name: Horror at Groundbreaking!
cards.text: An ancient stone is disturbed by the construction, releasing 2 monsters into the Miskatonic U. streets.

cards.name: Icy Conditions
cards.text: Investigators receive 1 less movement point during the Movement Phase. Fast Monsters move like normal monsters.

cards.name: Ill Wind Grips Arkham!
cards.text: The first player must pass a Luck (-1) check or be Cursed

rules_notes.text: Despite the name of the card, the first player must pass the check even if he currently is in an other world.

cards.name: Lodge Member Held for Questioning!
cards.text: A Silver Lodge ritual lets 2 monsters loose in the French Hill streets.

cards.name: Lodge Members Watch the Night!
cards.text: All monsters in the French Hill streets or locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: Manhunt in Arkham!
cards.text: All monsters in locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: The Man in Black
cards.text: Investigators who end their movement in the French Hill streets may deal with the Man in Black to gain power. They roll dice equal to their current Sanity and for every failed die, the lose 1 Sanity. If this reduces them to 0 Sanity, they are devoured and the player must start a new character. Otherwise, they gain 1 Clue token and draw 1 Spell.

cards.name: Merchants March on Crime!
cards.text: All monsters in the Merchant Dist. streets or locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: Miskatonic Arctic Expedition Returns!
cards.text: Any Elder Things previously claimed as monster trophies by players return to life and are placed in the River Docks.

cards.name: Missing People Return!
cards.text: All investigators currently lost in time and space immediately return to Arkham, appearing in a street or location of their choice.

cards.name: Noden's Favor
cards.text: It costs 2 fewer Clue tokens to seal gates.

cards.name: No One Can Help You Now
cards.text: Gates cannot be sealed, although they can still be closed.

cards.name: Picnickers Panic!
cards.text: A careless picnicker unleashes 2 monsters on the Downtown streets.

cards.name: Planetary Alignment
cards.text: Thanks to the mystic energy generated by the planetary alignment, all Spells have a Sanity cost of 0.

cards.name: Police Step Up Patrols in Northside!
cards.text: All monsters in the Northside streets or locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: Private Security Hired in Uptown!
cards.text: All monsters in the Uptown streets or locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: Raining Cats and Dogs
cards.text: Speed checks in Arkham are made at a -1 penalty, and players receive one less movement point during the Movement Phase. Sneak checks in Arkham are made at a +1 bonus. Return any Fire Vampires in play to the cup. If a Fire Vampire enters play, return it to the cup and draw a different monster.

cards.name: Rivertown Residents Take Back Streets!
cards.text: All monsters in the Rivertown streets or locations are returned to the cup.

cards.name: R'lyeh Rising
cards.text: Star Spawn and Maniacs have their toughness increased by 1. The difficulty to seal or close gates to R'lyeh is increased by 1.

cards.name: Scientist Warns of Dimensional Rift!
cards.text: All Dimensional Shamblers and Hounds of Tindalos are returned to the cup. If one or more monster is returned to the cup, raise the terror level by 1.

cards.name: Sheldon Gang Turns to Police for Aid!
cards.text: The Sheldon Gang disturbs a burial mound, releasing 2 monsters into the Uptown Streets.

cards.name: Slum Murders Continue!
cards.text: An old basement is opened, releasing 2 monsters into the Easttown Streets

cards.name: Solar Eclipse
cards.text: Due to the interference of the solar eclipse, no spells may be cast

cards.name: The Southside Strangler Strikes
cards.text: Return one Ally from the Ally deck to the box at random at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it entered play). The Southside Strangler has struck again! If a single player discards 5 Clue tokens while in Ma's Boarding House during the Arkham Encounters Phase, return this card to the box. Each player receives a $5 reward from the police. If there are no more Allies to return to the box at the end of the Mythos Phase, return this card to the box. Each player must lower either their maximum Sanity or Stamina (their choice) by 1 for the rest of the game.
cards.ongoing_effect: Return one Ally from the Ally deck to the box at random at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it entered play). The Southside Strangler has struck again!
cards.pass_condition: If a single player discards 5 Clue tokens while in Ma's Boarding House during the Arkham Encounters Phase, return this card to the box. Each player receives a $5 reward from the police.
cards.fail_condition: If there are no more Allies to return to the box at the end of the Mythos Phase, return this card to the box. Each player must lower either their maximum Sanity or Stamina (their choice) by 1 for the rest of the game.

rules_notes.text: The Pass condition should be resolved in the Southside Streets instead of Ma's Boarding House.

cards.name: Southside Strangler Suspected!
cards.text: However, the press is mistaken, and the murders were caused by 2 monsters that are released into the Southside streets.

cards.name: The Stars Are Right
cards.text: Roll a die at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it enters play). On a 1 or 2, place one doom token on the ancient one's doom track. If a player discards an Ally card while in the Downtown streets during the Arkham Encounter Phase, return this card to the box. Each player draws 2 Common Items. If the Ancient One awakens, return this card to the box.
cards.ongoing_effect: Roll a die at the end of every Mythos Phase while this card is in play (beginning the turn after it enters play). On a 1 or 2, place one doom token on the ancient one's doom track.
cards.pass_condition: If a player discards an Ally card while in the Downtown streets during the Arkham Encounter Phase, return this card to the box. Each player draws 2 Common Items.
cards.fail_condition: If the Ancient One awakens, return this card to the box.

cards.name: The Story Continues...
cards.text: Shuffle the mythos deck, being sure to include this card in it. After the deck is shuffled, draw a new mythos card for the turn.
cards.flavor_text: "I cannot remember, I must not remember what I saw on that dark and foreboding night.."

cards.name: Strange Lights on Campus!
cards.text: The Library, Administration Building and Science Building are all closed until the end of next turn. Leave this card in play until then to indicate this.

cards.name: Strange Power Flux Plagues City!
